title: Bug 659659: [Master Data Management] Fix cross-environment setup wizard UX quirks
summary: Master Data Management setup wizard improves certificate handling by deferring validation messages until a password is entered and fixes repeated reset confirmation prompts by tracking actual state changes.
key_points: No validation message shown until password entered for certificate upload; Certificate Password marked required with Next disabled
OnModify now only triggers enable/disable side effects when the stored Is Enabled state actually changes in the database
Prevents repeated reset confirmation questions after wizard enables synchronization
Shortens connection step by dropping redundant instructional text and showing certificate details only after successful read
